title: pane-session v1
description: A file in ~/.claude/pane-sessions, named <pane number>.json, written by Claude Code's SessionStart hook: the hook's input, verbatim. This schema DESCRIBES the format as it is on disk (census of 163 real files, 2026-09-29); Horde never writes these files. A file with no schemaVersion is v1.

schemaVersion.description: Absent in every file today; absence means 1. Reserved so a later format can say what it is.

session_id.description: The conversation id. wezfleet refuses a file whose id does not have this shape.

transcript_path.description: Where the conversation's transcript is. A snapshot that can rot: Horde derives the path rather than trusting this (core/ownership.json).

cwd.description: The working directory when the session started.

source.description: Why the session started. Seen: startup 117, resume 32, compact 11, wezfleet-backfill 2 (written by wezfleet pane-sessions -Apply, not the hook), clear 1. Not an enum: Claude Code may add values.

x-horde-file.name: ^[0-9]{1,9}\.json$, the WezTerm pane number - which names no terminal instance
x-horde-file.written: The file's last-write time is the only record of when it was written; nothing inside says so.
x-horde-file.readers: wezfleet Read-WfPaneSessionFile (lib/Registry.ps1) refuses a file whose name is not a pane number, whose session_id has the wrong shape, that was written before the current terminal instance started, or while more than one wezterm-gui runs. wezterm-resurrect read_pane_session (plugin/resurrect/process_handlers.lua) reads session_id and transcript_path.
x-horde-file.writers: Claude Code's SessionStart hook (cat > <pane>.json); wezfleet Write-WfPaneSessionRecord with source wezfleet-backfill.
